final_cleanup.scope: read-only final check of known hardware devices

source_references.use: Astra series identification example only; exact physical variant not inferred

limitations: No real commercial SKU confirmation for RPLIDAR or exact motor/MCU/IMU/servo labels
No wheel position or direction/distance calibration, ground braking, lost-process protection, simultaneous sensor or navigation integration acceptance
Depth initial zero and startup failures retained; post-replug one continuous run and one restart passed, long-term reliability unknown
No confirmed motorized gimbal; physical camera motion failed observational acceptance
RGB MP4 header 20fps differs from actual ~30fps; frames.jsonl is timing basis
Raw lidar samples contain Infinity for invalid distances; apply finite/range filtering
No remote backup or cross-chat dispatch performed; raw evidence is ignored by Git
Unified product diagnostic CLI deferred; bounded collectors archived here
hash_notes: SHA256 of exact bytes; evidence snapshots in stage/before excluded to avoid duplicate bulk. Manifest itself excluded from its own hash list.
